sources.title: Rio Tinto begins restarting Oyu Tolgoi underground operations after seismic event
evidence: following a seismic event that temporarily halted mining activities.
The miner said a seismic event on October 29 triggered a localised rockfall
The miner owns 66% of the project, with the Mongolian government holding the remainder.
The miner said three employees sustained injuries, and no fatalities were reported,
Rio Tinto also flagged delays affecting all vehicles passing through the Ganqimaodu border crossing
between China and Mongolia, which have reduced the availability of trucks
to transport copper concentrate from Oyu Tolgoi.

sources.title: 포스코 노사 임단협 잠정합의…기본급 2.6% 인상, 일시금 600만원
evidence: 노조가 밝힌 잠정합의안에 따르면 기본급 2.6% 상승, 일시금 600만원에 특별승호 3호봉을 확보했다.
특히 노조가 무제한 파업을 예고한 11월 2일 직전에 잠정 합의안을 마련하며 분쟁 장기화를 막아세웠다.
노조는 노동조합 규약에 따라 이날부터 일주일 뒤인 11월 7일 조합원 찬반투표를 실시한다.

sources.title: Mixed reactions to UK’s proposed 65% out-of-quota PET safeguard duty
evidence: and recycled PET (rPET) have received mixed reactions from market participants following the announcement on 23 October.
Under the proposed measures, imports of PET and rPET with a viscosity of 74ml/g and higher will be subject to a 65% duty
by 23:59 GMT on 22 November 2026 via the TRA website.
The measure would apply for no more than 200 days, or until a definitive measure is implemented, whichever comes first.
